name: flywheel-payload-endpoint
description: FLY-1062 PR3 · gated payload distribution endpoint (Cloudflare Worker). The single trusted write choke point for the R2 bucket: customer reads (entitlement views), publish writes (manifest single-object CAS + capability diffs + releaseOps idempotency ledger), ops cleanup guards. Uses the shared release contract and aws4fetch for short-lived R2 GET signatures.
